@FusionLogReplay.replay_complete_events : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (reference current : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered reference.placed →
      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered current.placed →
        FusionLogReplay.packetSet current.placed = FusionLogReplay.packetSet reference.placed →
          ∃ route,
            FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F current route = FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word ∧
              RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F current route).placed ∧
                FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F current route).placed =
                    FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F reference word).placed ∧
                  route.length ≤ (4 * n - 2) * (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word).length
@FusionLogReplay.sourceOrdered_log_endpoint_representative : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered s.state.placed →
      ∃ representative,
        (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s representative).fullLog =
            (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).fullLog ∧
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s representative).state.placed =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).state.placed ∧
            representative.length ≤
              (4 * n - 2) * (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F s.state word).length +
                  (3 * n - (FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed).card) *
                    ((FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed).card - 1) +
                (n - 1)
@FusionLogReplay.firstEvent_replay_step : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (reference current : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered reference.placed →
      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered current.placed →
        FusionLogReplay.packetSet current.placed = FusionLogReplay.packetSet reference.placed →
          FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word ≠ [] →
            ∃ u v stage,
              word = u ++ RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter.d :: v ∧
                RegisteredAbsorptionChains.FusionFree F reference u ∧
                  FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word =
                      [stage.event] ++
                        FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F
                          (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.step F (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F reference u)
                            RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter.d)
                          v ∧
                    FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F current stage.word = [stage.event] ∧
                      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered stage.next.placed ∧
                        FusionLogReplay.packetSet stage.next.placed =
                            FusionLogReplay.packetSet
                              (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.step F (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F reference u)
                                  RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter.d).placed ∧
                          stage.gap ≤ n - FusionLogReplay.packetRank current.placed ∧
                            stage.word.length ≤ 3 * n + stage.gap ∧
                              stage.budget.batches ≤ 1 ∧
                                stage.budget.holeTransfers = stage.gap ∧ (stage.gap = 0 → stage.budget.batches = 0)
@FusionLogReplay.packetRank_run_ledger : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered s.placed →
      FusionLogReplay.packetRank (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s word).placed +
          (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F s word).length =
        FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.placed
@FusionLogReplay.prefix_rank_and_holes : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered s.placed →
      FusionLogReplay.packetRank (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s word).placed =
          FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.placed - (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F s word).length ∧
        n - FusionLogReplay.packetRank (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s word).placed =
          n - FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.placed + (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F s word).length
@FusionLogReplay.replay_complete_events_plan : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (reference current : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered reference.placed →
      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered current.placed →
        FusionLogReplay.packetSet current.placed = FusionLogReplay.packetSet reference.placed →
          ∃ last plan,
            plan.events = FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word ∧
              RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered last.placed ∧
                FusionLogReplay.packetSet last.placed =
                  FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F reference word).placed
@FusionLogReplay.sourceOrdered_log_endpoint_budget : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered s.state.placed →
      ∃ plan,
        (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s plan.word).fullLog = (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).fullLog ∧
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s plan.word).state.placed =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).state.placed ∧
            plan.word.length ≤
                FusionLogReplay.normalFormBudget n (FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.state.placed)
                  (FusionLogReplay.packetRank (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed) ∧
              plan.batches ≤ FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.state.placed - 1 ∧
                plan.transfers ≤
                  FusionLogReplay.normalFormTransferBudget n (FusionLogReplay.packetRank s.state.placed)
                    (FusionLogReplay.packetRank (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed)
